/** geolabXL library version and date. */
geolab_version = LAMBDA("geolabXL 0.1 (2026-11-05)");

/** AASHTO soil classification with group index, as text. Inputs: % passing No.10, No.40, No.200 (enter 40 for 40%), LL_, PL_. */
classify_AASHTO = LAMBDA(pf10_, pf40_, pf200_, LL_, PL_,
    LET(
        LL, IF(ISOMITTED(LL_), 0, LL_),
        PL, IF(ISOMITTED(PL_), 0, PL_),
        PI, LL-PL,
        g, MAX(0, (pf200_-35)*(0.2+0.005*(LL-40))+0.01*(pf200_-15)*(PI-10)),
        GI, "("&g&")",
        IFS(pf10_<pf40_, "% passing No.10 must be larger than % passing No.40", pf40_<pf200_, "% passing No.40 must be larger than % passing No.200", LL<PL, "liquid limit must be larger or equal plastic limit", AND(pf10_<50, pf40_<30, pf200_<15, PI<6), "A-1a - Stone fragment gravel and sand", AND(pf40_<50, pf200_<25, PI<6), "A-1b - Stone fragment gravel and sand", AND(pf40_>51, pf200_<10, PL<=0), "A-3 - Fine sand", AND(pf200_<35, LL<40, PI<10), "A-2-4"&GI&" - Silty or clayey gravel sand", AND(pf200_<35, LL>41, PI<10), "A-2-5"&GI&" - Silty or clayey gravel sand", AND(pf200_<35, LL<40, PI>11), "A-2-6"&GI&" - Silty or clayey gravel sand", AND(pf200_<35, LL>41, PI>11), "A-2-7"&GI&" - Silty or clayey gravel sand", AND(pf200_>=36, LL<40, PI<10), "A-4"&GI&" - Silty soil", AND(pf200_>=36, LL>41, PI<10), "A-5"&GI&" - Silty soil", AND(pf200_>=36, LL<40, PI>11), "A-6"&GI&" - Clayey soil", AND(pf200_>=36, LL>41, PI>11, PL>30), "A-7-5"&GI&" - Clayey soil", AND(pf200_>=36, LL>41, PI>11, PL<30), "A-7-6"&GI&" - Clayey soil", TRUE, "N-C")
    ));

/** ASTM classification lookup: 100 rows {group symbol, group name}, in the original row order with repeated symbols. Use ASTMtable as the first argument of classify_ASTM. Stored in the library, so no ASTMnames worksheet is needed. */
ASTMtable = {"Pt","Peat";"SW","Well-graded sand";"SW","Well-graded sand with gravel";"SP","Poorly graded sand";"SP","Poorly graded sand with gravel";"SW-SM","Well-graded sand with gravel";"ML","Sandy silt";"ML","Sandy silt with gravel";"ML","Gravelly silt";"ML","Gravelly silt with sand";"OML","Organic silt";"OML","Organic silt with sand";"OML","Organic silt with /** USCS symbol with ASTM group name from a two-column lookup table (symbol | descriptions). Inputs: list (normally ASTMtable; "" also uses ASTMtable), % passing No.4 and No.200, optional Cu, Cc, LL, PL, organic. */
classify_ASTM = LAMBDA(list, pf4_, pf200_, [Cu_], [Cc_], [LL_], [PL_], [organic_],
    LET(
        organic, IF(ISOMITTED(organic_), 0, organic_),
        Cu, IF(ISOMITTED(Cu_), 0, Cu_),
        Cc, IF(ISOMITTED(Cc_), 0, Cc_),
        LL, IF(ISOMITTED(LL_), 0, LL_),
        PL, IF(ISOMITTED(PL_), 0, PL_),
        sand, pf4_-pf200_,
        gravel, 100-pf4_,
        plus, 100-pf200_,
        USC_, classify_USC(pf4_, pf200_, Cu, Cc, LL, PL, organic),
        sym, IF(USC_="CL & ML", "CL-ML", USC_),
        isOrg, AND(organic>0, OR(sym="ML", sym="CL", sym="CL-ML", sym="MH", sym="CH")),
        key, IF(isOrg, IF(OR(sym="MH", sym="CH"), "OCH", "OML"), sym),
        offset, IF(AND(isOrg, OR(sym="CL", sym="CL-ML", sym="MH")), 7, 0),
        i, IFS(plus<15, 1, plus<30, IF(sand>=gravel, 2, 3), sand>=gravel, IF(gravel>=15, 5, 4), TRUE, IF(sand>=15, 7, 6)),
        other, IF(LEFT(sym, 1)="G", sand, gravel),
        j, IF(key="Pt", 1, IF(pf200_>=50, i+offset, IF(other<15, 1, 2))),
        tbl, IF(COLUMNS(list)<2, ASTMtable, list),
        g, FILTER(tbl, CHOOSECOLS(tbl, 1)=key, ""),
        IF(isOrg, IF(key="OCH", "OH", "OL"), INDEX(g, j, 1))&" - "&INDEX(g, j, 2)
    ));

/** Fine-grained soil symbol from the plasticity chart (CL, CH, ML, MH, OL, OH, CL & ML). Inputs: LL, PL in %, optional organic (0 = inorganic). */
classify_Plasticity = LAMBDA(LL, PL, [organic],
    LET(
        organic_, IF(ISOMITTED(organic), 0, organic),
        PI, LL-PL,
        isAboveUline, IFS(LL<7, PI>LL, AND(7<=LL, LL<=15), PI>7, TRUE, PI>0.9*(LL-8)),
        isAboveAline, IF(LL<25.48, PI>4, PI>0.73*(LL-20)),
        IFS(LL<PL, "Error: Liquid limit must be larger or equal to plastic limit", isAboveUline, "Error: Above U line in plasticity chart", AND(4<=PI, PI<=7, LL>PI, PI>=0.73*(LL-20)), "CL & ML", isAboveAline, IF(organic=0, "C", "O")&IF(LL>50, "H", "L"), TRUE, IF(organic=0, "M", "O")&IF(LL>50, "H", "L"))
    ));

/** USCS group symbol from gradation and plasticity. Inputs: % passing No.4 and No.200, optional Cu = D60/D10, Cc = D30²/(D10·D60), LL, PL, organic. */
classify_USC = LAMBDA(pf4_, pf200_, [Cu_], [Cc_], [LL_], [PL_], [organic_],
    LET(
        organic, IF(ISOMITTED(organic_), 0, organic_),
        Cu, IF(ISOMITTED(Cu_), 0, Cu_),
        Cc, IF(ISOMITTED(Cc_), 0, Cc_),
        LL, IF(ISOMITTED(LL_), 0, LL_),
        PL, IF(ISOMITTED(PL_), 0, PL_),
        fines, classify_Plasticity(LL, PL),
        clayFines, LEFT(fines, 1)="C",
        isSand, pf4_-pf200_>=100-pf4_,
        isWellGraded, IF(isSand, AND(Cu>6, Cc>1, Cc<3), AND(Cu>4, Cc>1, Cc<3)),
        IFS(pf4_<pf200_, "Error: Percent passing No.4 must be larger than percent passing No.200", organic>90, "Pt", LEFT(fines, 3)="Err", fines, AND(0<=pf200_, pf200_<5), IF(isSand, IF(isWellGraded, "SW", "SP"), IF(isWellGraded, "GW", "GP")), AND(5<=pf200_, pf200_<12, isSand), IF(isWellGraded, IF(clayFines, "SW-SC", "SW-SM"), IF(clayFines, "SP-SC", "SP-SM")), AND(5<=pf200_, pf200_<12, NOT(isSand)), IF(isWellGraded, IF(clayFines, "GW-GC", "GW-GM"), IF(clayFines, "GP-GC", "GP-GM")), AND(12<=pf200_, pf200_<50, fines="CL & ML"), IF(isSand, "SC-SM", "GC-GM"), AND(12<=pf200_, pf200_<50), IF(clayFines, IF(isSand, "SC", "GC"), IF(isSand, "SM", "GM")), pf200_>=50, fines)
    ));

/** Time factor Tv from average degree of consolidation U (fraction, 0 ≤ U < 1), approximate formula. */
consolidation_Tv = LAMBDA(U, IF(U>0.6, -0.085-0.933*LOG(1-U), PI()/4*U^2));

/** Average degree of consolidation U (fraction) from time factor tv by Fourier series. case_: uniform (default), triangular_top, triangular_bottom, vshape, saw, sine, parabolic, circular. */
consolidation_U = LAMBDA(tv, [case_],
    LET(
        cases, {"uniform", "triangular_top", "triangular_bottom", "vshape", "saw", "sine", "parabolic", "circular"},
        caseIndex, IF(ISOMITTED(case_), 1, XMATCH(LOWER(case_), cases, 0)),
        n, SEQUENCE(1, MIN(1000, 2+INT(SQRT(160/MAX(MIN(tv), 1E-6))/PI()))),
        np, n*PI(),
        sn, IF(MOD(n, 2), (-1)^((n-1)/2), 0),
        en, IF(np^2*tv/4>700, 0, 1/EXP(np^2*tv/4)),
        cm, SWITCH(caseIndex, 1, 8*sn^4/np^2, 2, IF(MOD(n, 2), 8/np^2, 0), 3, IF(MOD(n, 2), 8/np^2, 0), 4, 16*sn^3*(np*sn-2)/np^3, 5, 32*sn^3/np^3, 6, IF(n=1, 1, 0), 7, IF(MOD(n, 2), 96/np^4, 0), 8, IF(MOD(n, 2), -16*(-1)^((n+1)/2)*BESSELJ(np/2, 1)/np^2, 0), 0, 0),
        1-BYROW(cm*en, LAMBDA(x, SUM(x)))
    ));

/** Excess pore pressure ratio u/u0 along normalized depth at time factor tv. Inputs: Xarray (z/H column), tv, case_ (same cases as consolidation_U). */
consolidation_Ux = LAMBDA(Xarray, tv, [case_],
    LET(
        cases, {"uniform", "triangular_top", "triangular_bottom", "vshape", "saw", "sine", "parabolic", "circular"},
        caseIndex, IF(ISOMITTED(case_), 1, XMATCH(LOWER(case_), cases, 0)),
        n, SEQUENCE(1, MIN(1000, 2+INT(SQRT(160/MAX(MIN(tv), 1E-6))/PI()))),
        np, n*PI(),
        sn, IF(MOD(n, 2), (-1)^((n-1)/2), 0),
        en, IF(np^2*tv/4>700, 0, 1/EXP(np^2*tv/4)),
        cm, SWITCH(caseIndex, 1, 4*sn^2/np, 2, -2*(-1)^n/np, 3, 2/np, 4, 4*sn*(np*sn-2)/np^2, 5, 8*sn/np^2, 6, IF(n=1, 1, 0), 7, IF(MOD(n, 2), -8*(-1)^n/np^3, 0), 8, 2*sn/n*BESSELJ(np/2, 1), 0, 0),
        BYROW(Xarray, LAMBDA(x, SUM(cm*en*SIN(np*x))))
    ));

/** Average degree of consolidation U (fraction) from tv, closed-form approximation. */
consolidation_U_approximate = LAMBDA(tv,
    LET(
        U, 2*SQRT(tv/PI()),
        IF(U<0.6, U, 1-8/PI()^2/EXP(PI()^2/4*tv))
    ));

/** Average consolidation U for a load applied linearly over construction time factor tc. Inputs: tv, tc. */
consolidation_U_variable = LAMBDA(tv, tc, IF(tv<tc, consolidation_U(tv/2)*tv/tc, consolidation_U(tv-tc/2)));

/** Cosine of an angle in degrees. */
cosd = LAMBDA(X, COS(RADIANS(X)));

/** Interpolate y at X from (Xa, Ya); X may be a column. Xa may be increasing or decreasing. mode: "linear" (default), "logx", "logy", "logxy". outside: omitted = #N/A, "extrapolate", "clamp". */
Interpolate = LAMBDA(X, Xa, Ya, [mode], [outside],
    LET(
        md, IF(ISOMITTED(mode), "LINEAR", UPPER(mode)),
        od, IF(ISOMITTED(outside), "ERROR", UPPER(outside)),
        lx, OR(md = "LOGX", md = "LOGXY"),
        ly, OR(md = "LOGY", md = "LOGXY"),
        xs, SORTBY(TOCOL(Xa), TOCOL(Xa)),
        ys, SORTBY(TOCOL(Ya), TOCOL(Xa)),
        n, ROWS(xs),
        xlo, INDEX(xs, 1),
        xhi, INDEX(xs, n),
        q, IF(od = "CLAMP", IF(X < xlo, xlo, IF(X > xhi, xhi, X)), X),
        iRaw, IFERROR(XMATCH(q, xs, -1, 2), 1),
        i, IF(iRaw > n - 1, n - 1, iRaw),
        xA, INDEX(xs, i),
        xB, INDEX(xs, i + 1),
        yA, INDEX(ys, i),
        yB, INDEX(ys, i + 1),
        t, IF(lx, LN(q/xA)/LN(xB/xA), (q - xA)/(xB - xA)),
        y, IF(ly, yA*(yB/yA)^t, yA + t*(yB - yA)),
        outRange, (q < xlo) + (q > xhi),
        IF(outRange*(od = "ERROR"), NA(), IF(xB = xA, yA, y))
    ));

/** Sine of an angle in degrees. */
sind = LAMBDA(X, SIN(RADIANS(X)));

/** Normal and shear stress {s, t} on a plane at angle alpha (deg) using the Mohr circle pole. Inputs: sa, ta pole stresses, alpha, sm circle centre. */
Stress_Mohr = LAMBDA(sa, ta, alpha, sm,
    LET(
        ar, RADIANS(alpha),
        am, 2*(sm-sa)*COS(ar)-2*ta*SIN(ar),
        s, sa+am*COS(ar),
        t, ta+am*SIN(ar),
        HSTACK(s, t)
    ));

/** Mohr–Coulomb failure circle through a known stress (sa, ta) on plane A (deg): centre, radius, pole, principal and failure stresses. passive: omit = active. */
stress_Mohr_failure = LAMBDA(sa, ta, A, phi, coh, [passive],
    LET(
        f, RADIANS(phi),
        sgn, IF(ISOMITTED(passive), -1, 1),
        sm, sa/COS(f)^2+coh*TAN(f)+sgn*SQRT((coh+sa*TAN(f))^2-ta^2)/COS(f),
        rValue, SQRT((sa-sm)^2+ta^2),
        ar, IF(A=0, 0.000001, RADIANS(A)),
        am, 2*(sm-sa)*COS(ar)-2*ta*SIN(ar),
        sp, sa+am*COS(ar),
        tp, ta+am*SIN(ar),
        s1_, sm+rValue,
        s3_, sm-rValue,
        a1_, DEGREES(ATAN2(s1_-sp, -tp)),
        a3_, DEGREES(ATAN2(s3_-sp, -tp)),
        ap, DEGREES(ATAN2(sm-sp, -tp))+90,
        sf, sm*COS(f)^2-coh*SIN(2*f)/2,
        tfp, coh*COS(f)^2+sm*SIN(f)*COS(f),
        afp, DEGREES(ATAN2(sf-sp, tfp-tp)),
        tfn, -tfp,
        afn, DEGREES(ATAN2(sf-sp, tfn-tp)),
        header, {"", "Normal stress", "Shear stress", "Surface orientation (deg)"},
        ra, HSTACK("Center =", sm, "", ""),
        rb, HSTACK("Radius =", rValue, "", ""),
        rj, HSTACK(header),
        rd, HSTACK("Pole", sp, tp, ap),
        re, HSTACK("Major principal stress", s1_, 0, a1_),
        rf, HSTACK("Minor principal stress", s3_, 0, a3_),
        rg, HSTACK("Minor principal stress", s3_, 0, a3_),
        rh, HSTACK("Failure stress", sf, tfp, afp),
        ri, HSTACK("Failure stress", sf, tfn, afn),
        VSTACK(ra, rb, rj, rd, re, rf, rg, rh, ri)
    ));

/** Mohr circle and pole from stresses on two perpendicular planes: centre, radius, pole, principal stresses. Inputs: sa, ta on plane A (deg), sb normal stress on the perpendicular plane. */
stress_Mohr_pole = LAMBDA(sa, ta, A, sb,
    LET(
        tb, -ta,
        B, A+90,
        sm, (sa+sb)/2,
        rValue, SQRT((sa-sb)^2/4+ta^2),
        ar, IF(A=0, 0.000001, RADIANS(A)),
        am, 2*(sm-sa)*COS(ar)-2*ta*SIN(ar),
        sp, sa+am*COS(ar),
        tp, ta+am*SIN(ar),
        s1_, sm+rValue,
        s3_, sm-rValue,
        a1_, DEGREES(ATAN2(s1_-sp, -tp)),
        a3_, DEGREES(ATAN2(s3_-sp, -tp)),
        ap, DEGREES(ATAN2(sm-sp, -tp))+90,
        header, {"", "Normal stress", "Shear stress", "Surface orientation (deg)"},
        VSTACK(HSTACK("Center =", sm, "", ""), HSTACK("Radius =", rValue, "", ""), HSTACK(header), HSTACK("Stress b", sb, tb, B), HSTACK("Pole", sp, tp, ap), HSTACK("Major principal stress", s1_, 0, a1_), HSTACK("Minor principal stress", s3_, 0, a3_))
    ));

/** Plotting points {σ, τ} of a Mohr circle with centre sm and radius rValue (header + 21 points). */
stress_Mohrcircle = LAMBDA(sm, rValue,
    LET(
        a, SEQUENCE(21)*PI()/10,
        s, sm+rValue*COS(a),
        t, rValue*SIN(a),
        header, {"sig", "tau"},
        VSTACK(header, HSTACK(s, t))
    ));

/** Tangent of an angle in degrees. */
tand = LAMBDA(X, TAN(RADIANS(X)));

/** Bilinear interpolation in a 2-D table. Inputs: x, Y query; XY table with x values in row 1 and y values in column 1 (ascending). */
interpolate_table = LAMBDA(x, Y, XY,
    LET(
        Xa, DROP(CHOOSEROWS(XY, 1), , 1),
        Ya, DROP(CHOOSECOLS(XY, 1), 1),
        Za, DROP(XY, 1, 1),
        cValue, XMATCH(x, Xa, -1),
        rValue, XMATCH(Y, Ya, -1),
        Xl, INDEX(Xa, cValue),
        Xu, INDEX(Xa, cValue+1),
        Yl, INDEX(Ya, rValue),
        Yu, INDEX(Ya, rValue+1),
        a, (Xu-Xl)*(Yu-Yl),
        Nll, (Xu-x)*(Yu-Y),
        Nul, (x-Xl)*(Yu-Y),
        Nuu, (x-Xl)*(Y-Yl),
        Nlu, (Xu-x)*(Y-Yl),
        Zll, INDEX(Za, rValue, cValue),
        Zlu, INDEX(Za, rValue+1, cValue),
        Zuu, INDEX(Za, rValue+1, cValue+1),
        Zul, INDEX(Za, rValue+1, cValue),
        (Nll*Zll+Nlu*Zlu+Nuu*Zuu+Nul*Zul)/a
    ));

/** Staircase table: each x repeated twice with y shifted one row, for step plots. Inputs: x, y columns. */
Step_table = LAMBDA(x, y,
    LET(
        n, ROWS(x),
        x_extended, INDEX(x, INT((SEQUENCE(2*n, 1, 1, 1)+1)/2)),
        y_extended, INDEX(y, INT((SEQUENCE(2*n, 1, 0, 1)+1)/2)),
        HSTACK(x_extended, y_extended)
    ));

/** Grain-size analysis: {D10; D30; D60; Cu; Cc; % clay; % silt; % sand; % gravel}. Inputs: d diameters (mm), p percent passing (any order). */
grainsizeanalysis = LAMBDA(d, p,
    LET(
        Pmin, MIN(p),
        Pmax, MAX(p),
        D10_, IF(AND(Pmin<10, 10<Pmax), Interpolate(10, p, d, "logy"), 0),
        D30_, IF(AND(Pmin<30, 30<Pmax), Interpolate(30, p, d, "logy"), 0),
        D60_, IF(AND(Pmin<60, 60<Pmax), Interpolate(60, p, d, "logy"), 0),
        Dmin, MIN(d),
        Dmax, MAX(d),
        clay, IF(Dmin<=0.005, Interpolate(0.005, d, p, "logx"), 0),
        silt, IF(Dmin<=0.075, Interpolate(0.075, d, p, "logx"), 0),
        sand, IF(Dmax>=4.75, Interpolate(4.75, d, p, "logx"), 100),
        gravel, IF(Dmax>=75, Interpolate(75, d, p, "logx"), 100),
        VSTACK(D10_, D30_, D60_, IF(D10_>0, D60_/D10_, 0), IF(AND(D10_>0, D60_>0), D30_^2/D10_/D60_, 0), clay, silt-clay, sand-silt, gravel-sand)
    ));

/** ASTM D2487 group symbol and group name {symbol, name}. Inputs: % passing No. 4 and No. 200, optional Cu, Cc, LL, PL, LL oven-dried/LL not dried (blank = inorganic). */
classify_ASTM2487 = LAMBDA(pf4, pf200, [cu_], [cc_], [ll_], [pl_], [ratio_],
LET(
cuV, IF(ISOMITTED(cu_), 0, N(cu_)),
ccV, IF(ISOMITTED(cc_), 0, N(cc_)),
llV, IF(ISOMITTED(ll_), 0, N(ll_)),
plV, IF(ISOMITTED(pl_), 0, N(pl_)),
rt, IF(ISOMITTED(ratio_), 1, IF(N(ratio_)=0, 1, N(ratio_))),
gravel, 100-pf4,
sand, pf4-pf200,
plus, 100-pf200,
piV, llV-plV,
above, piV>=0.73*(llV-20),
ftype, IF(OR(piV<4, NOT(above)), "M", IF(AND(llV<50, piV<=7), "CL-ML", "C")),
isG, gravel>sand,
gL, IF(isG, "G", "S"),
main, IF(isG, "gravel", "sand"),
other, IF(isG, "sand", "gravel"),
oPct, IF(isG, sand, gravel),
withO, IF(oPct>=15, " with "&other, ""),
andO, IF(oPct>=15, " and "&other, ""),
good, AND(cuV>=IF(isG, 4, 6), ccV>=1, ccV<=3),
grd, IF(good, "W", "P"),
grdTxt, IF(good, "Well-graded ", "Poorly graded "),
fm, IF(ftype="M", "M", "C"),
cSym, IFS(pf200<5, gL&grd, pf200<=12, gL&grd&"-"&gL&fm, ftype="M", gL&"M", ftype="C", gL&"C", TRUE, gL&"C-"&gL&"M"),
cName, IFS(pf200<5, grdTxt&main&withO,
           pf200<=12, grdTxt&main&IF(fm="M", " with silt"&andO, " with clay"&andO&" (or silty clay"&andO&")"),
           ftype="M", "Silty "&main&withO,
           ftype="C", "Clayey "&main&withO,
           TRUE, "Silty, clayey "&main&withO),
org, rt<0.75,
fSym, IF(org, IF(llV<50, "OL", "OH"),
         IF(llV<50, IF(NOT(above), "ML", IF(piV>7, "CL", IF(piV>=4, "CL-ML", "ML"))), IF(above, "CH", "MH"))),
base, IF(org, IF(IF(llV<50, AND(piV>=4, above), above), "organic clay", "organic silt"),
         SWITCH(fSym, "CL", "lean clay", "CL-ML", "silty clay", "ML", "silt", "CH", "fat clay", "elastic silt")),
capBase, UPPER(LEFT(base))&MID(base, 2, 50),
sg, sand>=gravel,
fName, IF(plus<15, capBase,
          IF(plus<30, capBase&IF(sg, " with sand", " with gravel"),
             IF(sg, "Sandy "&base&IF(gravel>=15, " with gravel", ""),
                    "Gravelly "&base&IF(sand>=15, " with sand", "")))),
IF(pf200<50, HSTACK(cSym, cName), HSTACK(fSym, fName))
));

/** Contour H=level traced cell by cell from the domain boundary; ~2 points per cell. seepage_eqline(xs,ys,H,level,[branch],[smooth],[nmax]) */
seepage_eqline = LAMBDA(xs, ys, H, level, [branch], [smooth], [nmax],
LET(xv,TOCOL(xs),yv,TOCOL(ys),n,ROWS(xv),m,ROWS(yv),lv,level,br,IF(ISOMITTED(branch),1,MAX(1,branch)),sm,IF(ISOMITTED(smooth),1,IF(smooth=0,0,1)),ncell,(n-1)*(m-1),nm,IF(ISOMITTED(nmax),ncell+1,IF(nmax>0,nmax,ncell+1)),tx,0.25*MEDIAN(ABS(DROP(xv,1)-DROP(xv,-1))),ty,0.25*MEDIAN(ABS(DROP(yv,1)-DROP(yv,-1))),OKG,MAKEARRAY(m-1,n-1,LAMBDA(rr,cc,seepage_cellok(xs,ys,H,rr,cc))),OK,LAMBDA(rr,cc,IF(OR(rr<1,cc<1,rr>m-1,cc>n-1),FALSE,INDEX(OKG,rr,cc))),EROWA,LAMBDA(rr,eg,IF(eg=3,rr+1,rr)),ECOLA,LAMBDA(cc,eg,IF(eg=2,cc+1,cc)),EROWB,LAMBDA(rr,eg,IF(eg=1,rr,rr+1)),ECOLB,LAMBDA(cc,eg,IF(eg=4,cc,cc+1)),CROSS,LAMBDA(rr,cc,eg,(INDEX(H,EROWA(rr,eg),ECOLA(cc,eg))>=lv)<>(INDEX(H,EROWB(rr,eg),ECOLB(cc,eg))>=lv)),EPT,LAMBDA(rr,cc,eg,LET(ia,EROWA(rr,eg),ja,ECOLA(cc,eg),ib,EROWB(rr,eg),jb,ECOLB(cc,eg),hza,INDEX(H,ia,ja),hzb,INDEX(H,ib,jb),tq,(lv-hza)/(hzb-hza),HSTACK(INDEX(xv,ja)+tq*(INDEX(xv,jb)-INDEX(xv,ja)),INDEX(yv,ia)+tq*(INDEX(yv,ib)-INDEX(yv,ia))))),NROW,LAMBDA(rr,eg,rr+IF(eg=1,-1,IF(eg=3,1,0))),NCOL,LAMBDA(cc,eg,cc+IF(eg=2,1,IF(eg=4,-1,0))),NENT,LAMBDA(eg,MOD(eg+1,4)+1),SEEDOK,LAMBDA(kq,LET(cq,INT((kq-1)/4),rr,INT(cq/(n-1))+1,cc,MOD(cq,n-1)+1,eg,MOD(kq-1,4)+1,IF(NOT(OK(rr,cc)),FALSE,IF(NOT(CROSS(rr,cc,eg)),FALSE,NOT(OK(NROW(rr,eg),NCOL(cc,eg))))))),allk,SEQUENCE(4*ncell),ks,FILTER(allk,MAP(allk,SEEDOK),0),IF(OR(INDEX(ks,1)=0,ROWS(ks)<br),NA(),LET(kq,INDEX(ks,br),cq,INT((kq-1)/4),rs,INT(cq/(n-1))+1,cs,MOD(cq,n-1)+1,es,MOD(kq-1,4)+1,INTERIOR,LAMBDA(rr,cc,px,py,qx,qy,LET(xa,INDEX(xv,cc),xb,INDEX(xv,cc+1),ya,INDEX(yv,rr),yb,INDEX(yv,rr+1),hA,INDEX(H,rr,cc),hB,INDEX(H,rr,cc+1),hC,INDEX(H,rr+1,cc),hD,INDEX(H,rr+1,cc+1),NW,LAMBDA(pt,LET(mx,INDEX(pt,1),my,INDEX(pt,2),tt,(mx-xa)/(xb-xa),uu,(my-ya)/(yb-ya),hh,(1-uu)*((1-tt)*hA+tt*hB)+uu*((1-tt)*hC+tt*hD),gx,((1-uu)*(hB-hA)+uu*(hD-hC))/(xb-xa),gy,((1-tt)*(hC-hA)+tt*(hD-hB))/(yb-ya),gg,gx^2+gy^2,IF(gg=0,pt,HSTACK(mx-(hh-lv)*gx/gg,my-(hh-lv)*gy/gg)))),pz,NW(NW(HSTACK((px+qx)/2,(py+qy)/2))),HSTACK(MIN(MAX(INDEX(pz,1),MIN(xa,xb)),MAX(xa,xb)),MIN(MAX(INDEX(pz,2),MIN(ya,yb)),MAX(ya,yb))))),STEP,LAMBDA(acc,it,LET(last,TAKE(acc,-1),rr,INDEX(last,1,3),cc,INDEX(last,1,4),eg,INDEX(last,1,5),IF(rr=0,acc,LET(ea,MOD(eg,4)+1,eb,MOD(eg+1,4)+1,ec,MOD(eg+2,4)+1,ex,IF(CROSS(rr,cc,ea),ea,IF(CROSS(rr,cc,eb),eb,IF(CROSS(rr,cc,ec),ec,0))),IF(ex=0,VSTACK(DROP(acc,-1),HSTACK(TAKE(last,,2),0,0,0)),LET(q,EPT(rr,cc,ex),qx,INDEX(q,1),qy,INDEX(q,2),px,INDEX(last,1,1),py,INDEX(last,1,2),rn,NROW(rr,ex),cn,NCOL(cc,ex),go,IF(OK(rn,cn),NOT(AND(rn=rs,cn=cs)),FALSE),newrow,IF(go,HSTACK(qx,qy,rn,cn,NENT(ex)),HSTACK(qx,qy,0,0,0)),thin,OR(ABS(INDEX(xv,cc+1)-INDEX(xv,cc))<tx,ABS(INDEX(yv,rr+1)-INDEX(yv,rr))<ty),IF(OR(sm=0,thin),VSTACK(acc,newrow),VSTACK(acc,HSTACK(INTERIOR(rr,cc,px,py,qx,qy),0,0,0),newrow)))))))),start,HSTACK(EPT(rs,cs,es),rs,cs,es),path,REDUCE(start,SEQUENCE(nm),STEP),TAKE(path,,2)))));

/** Several contours stacked with #N/A separators for one chart series. seepage_eqlines(xs,ys,H,levels,[smooth],[nmax]) */
seepage_eqlines = LAMBDA(xs, ys, H, levels, [smooth], [nmax],
LET(smArg,IF(ISOMITTED(smooth),1,smooth),nArg,IF(ISOMITTED(nmax),0,nmax),big,1E+300,sep,HSTACK(big,big),st,REDUCE(sep,TOCOL(levels),LAMBDA(acc,lv,LET(pts,seepage_eqline(xs,ys,H,lv,1,smArg,nArg),VSTACK(acc,IF(ISERROR(INDEX(pts,1,1)),sep,pts),sep)))),res,DROP(st,1),IF(res=big,NA(),res)));

/** Flow lines psi = levels traced from the head grid (#N/A separated). seepage_flowlines(xs,ys,H,levels,[k],[edge]) */
seepage_flowlines = LAMBDA(xs, ys, H, levels, [k], [edge],
LET(kv,IF(ISOMITTED(k),1,k),ev,IF(ISOMITTED(edge),0,edge),PS,seepage_psigrid(xs,ys,H,kv,0,ev),seepage_eqlines(xs,ys,PS,levels)));

/** Internal: nodal dh/dx (axis=1) or dh/dy (axis=2), wall/blank aware; edge 4=FD mass balance (default),1,2,3. seepage_gradgrid(xs,ys,H,axis,[edge]) */
seepage_gradgrid = LAMBDA(xs, ys, H, axis, [edge],
LET(xv,TOCOL(xs),yv,TOCOL(ys),n,ROWS(xv),m,ROWS(yv),tx,0.25*MEDIAN(ABS(DROP(xv,1)-DROP(xv,-1))),ty,0.25*MEDIAN(ABS(DROP(yv,1)-DROP(yv,-1))),ev,TOCOL(IF(ISOMITTED(edge),0,edge)),EMODE,LAMBDA(ee,IF(ee=1,1,IF(ee=2,2,IF(ee=3,3,4)))),eF,EMODE(INDEX(ev,1)),eL,EMODE(INDEX(ev,ROWS(ev))),NX,LAMBDA(ax,IF(ax=1,n,m)),HX,LAMBDA(ax,i,j,IF(ax=1,INDEX(H,j,i),INDEX(H,i,j))),CX,LAMBDA(ax,i,IF(ax=1,INDEX(xv,i),INDEX(yv,i))),ACTV,LAMBDA(ax,i,j,IF(OR(i<1,j<1,i>NX(ax),j>NX(3-ax)),FALSE,ISNUMBER(HX(ax,i,j)))),THIN,LAMBDA(ax,ia,ib,ABS(CX(ax,ib)-CX(ax,ia))<IF(ax=1,tx,ty)),NBR,LAMBDA(ax,i,j,dn,LET(kk,i+dn,IF(NOT(ACTV(ax,kk,j)),0,IF(THIN(ax,i,kk),IF(HX(ax,kk,j)<>HX(ax,i,j),0,LET(kb,kk+dn,IF(ACTV(ax,kb,j),kb,0))),kk)))),PRIM,LAMBDA(ax,i,j,IF(i<=1,i,IF(NOT(ACTV(ax,i-1,j)),i,IF(AND(THIN(ax,i-1,i),HX(ax,i-1,j)=HX(ax,i,j)),i-1,i)))),DQ,LAMBDA(pa,pb,pd,fa,fb,fd,xx,fa*((xx-pb)+(xx-pd))/((pa-pb)*(pa-pd))+fb*((xx-pa)+(xx-pd))/((pb-pa)*(pb-pd))+fd*((xx-pa)+(xx-pb))/((pd-pa)*(pd-pb))),NDERX,LAMBDA(ax,i,j,IF(NOT(ACTV(ax,i,j)),0,LET(iL,NBR(ax,i,j,-1),iR,NBR(ax,i,j,1),IF((iL=0)=(iR=0),0,LET(iq,IF(iR>0,iR,iL),jm,NBR(3-ax,j,i,-1),jp,NBR(3-ax,j,i,1),IF(OR(jm=0,jp=0),0,LET(dd,ABS(CX(ax,iq)-CX(ax,i)),dtm,ABS(CX(3-ax,j)-CX(3-ax,jm)),dtp,ABS(CX(3-ax,jp)-CX(3-ax,j)),aa,dd/2,bb,(dtm+dtp)/2,tsum,(HX(ax,i,jm)-HX(ax,i,j))/dtm+(HX(ax,i,jp)-HX(ax,i,j))/dtp,-(HX(ax,iq,j)-HX(ax,i,j))/dd-(aa/bb)*tsum))))))),DER,LAMBDA(ax,iorig,j,IF(NOT(ACTV(ax,iorig,j)),NA(),LET(i,PRIM(ax,iorig,j),iL,NBR(ax,i,j,-1),iR,NBR(ax,i,j,1),IF(AND(iL>0,iR>0),DQ(CX(ax,iL),CX(ax,i),CX(ax,iR),HX(ax,iL,j),HX(ax,i,j),HX(ax,iR,j),CX(ax,i)),IF(AND(iL=0,iR=0),0,LET(iq,IF(iR>0,iR,iL),md,IF(iL=0,eF,eL),dd,CX(ax,iq)-CX(ax,i),sg,SIGN(dd),IF(md=1,0,IF(md=2,(HX(ax,iq,j)-HX(ax,i,j))/dd,IF(md=3,LET(iqb,NBR(ax,iq,j,SIGN(iq-i)),IF(iqb=0,(HX(ax,iq,j)-HX(ax,i,j))/dd,DQ(CX(ax,i),CX(ax,iq),CX(ax,iqb),HX(ax,i,j),HX(ax,iq,j),HX(ax,iqb,j),CX(ax,i)))),LET(jm,NBR(3-ax,j,i,-1),jp,NBR(3-ax,j,i,1),IF(AND(jm>0,jp>0),-sg*NDERX(ax,i,j),IF(AND(jm=0,jp=0),(HX(ax,iq,j)-HX(ax,i,j))/dd,LET(jn,IF(jm>0,jm,jp),dt,ABS(CX(3-ax,jn)-CX(3-ax,j)),aa,ABS(dd)/2,bb,dt/2,sres,-((HX(ax,iq,j)-HX(ax,i,j))/ABS(dd)*bb+(HX(ax,i,jn)-HX(ax,i,j))/dt*aa),wc,bb*ABS(NDERX(ax,i,jn)),wt,aa*ABS(NDERX(3-ax,j,iq)),-sg*IF(wc+wt=0,sres/(aa+bb),sres*wc/(wc+wt)/bb)))))))))))))),MAKEARRAY(m,n,LAMBDA(rr,qq,IF(axis=1,DER(1,qq,rr),DER(2,rr,qq))))));

/** {h, dh/dx, dh/dy} at (x,y) by bilinear interpolation in the soil cell; #N/A outside the soil. seepage_hfield(xs,ys,H,x,y) */
seepage_hfield = LAMBDA(xs, ys, H, x, y,
LET(xv,TOCOL(xs),yv,TOCOL(ys),n,ROWS(xv),m,ROWS(yv),sx,SIGN(INDEX(xv,n)-INDEX(xv,1)),sy,SIGN(INDEX(yv,m)-INDEX(yv,1)),ci,MIN(MAX(SUM(--((xv-x)*sx<=0)),1),n-1),rj,MIN(MAX(SUM(--((yv-y)*sy<=0)),1),m-1),tx,0.25*MEDIAN(ABS(DROP(xv,1)-DROP(xv,-1))),ty,0.25*MEDIAN(ABS(DROP(yv,1)-DROP(yv,-1))),SCORE,LAMBDA(rr,cc,IF(OR(rr<1,cc<1,rr>m-1,cc>n-1),0,IF(OR(x<MIN(INDEX(xv,cc),INDEX(xv,cc+1))-0.000000000001,x>MAX(INDEX(xv,cc),INDEX(xv,cc+1))+0.000000000001,y<MIN(INDEX(yv,rr),INDEX(yv,rr+1))-0.000000000001,y>MAX(INDEX(yv,rr),INDEX(yv,rr+1))+0.000000000001),0,IF(NOT(seepage_cellok(xs,ys,H,rr,cc)),0,IF(OR(ABS(INDEX(xv,cc+1)-INDEX(xv,cc))<tx,ABS(INDEX(yv,rr+1)-INDEX(yv,rr))<ty),1,2))))),rlist,VSTACK(rj,rj,rj,rj-1,rj+1),clist,VSTACK(ci,ci-1,ci+1,ci,ci),sc,MAP(rlist,clist,LAMBDA(ra,ca,SCORE(ra,ca))),best,MAX(sc),IF(best=0,HSTACK(NA(),NA(),NA()),LET(kk,XMATCH(best,sc),rr,INDEX(rlist,kk),cc,INDEX(clist,kk),xa,INDEX(xv,cc),xb,INDEX(xv,cc+1),ya,INDEX(yv,rr),yb,INDEX(yv,rr+1),tt,(x-xa)/(xb-xa),uu,(y-ya)/(yb-ya),hA,INDEX(H,rr,cc),hB,INDEX(H,rr,cc+1),hC,INDEX(H,rr+1,cc),hD,INDEX(H,rr+1,cc+1),hh,(1-uu)*((1-tt)*hA+tt*hB)+uu*((1-tt)*hC+tt*hD),gx,((1-uu)*(hB-hA)+uu*(hD-hC))/(xb-xa),gy,((1-tt)*(hC-hA)+tt*(hD-hB))/(yb-ya),HSTACK(hh,gx,gy)))));

/** h at (x,y); x,y may be arrays. seepage_hxy(xs,ys,H,x,y) */
seepage_hxy = LAMBDA(xs, ys, H, x, y,
IF(COUNT(x)=1,INDEX(seepage_hfield(xs,ys,H,x,y),1),MAP(x,y,LAMBDA(px,py,INDEX(seepage_hfield(xs,ys,H,px,py),1)))));

/** Internal: stream function psi at every node from the heads (base = psiref, wall = flow line). seepage_psigrid(xs,ys,H,[k],[psiref],[edge]) */
seepage_psigrid = LAMBDA(xs, ys, H, [k], [psiref], [edge],
LET(kv,IF(ISOMITTED(k),1,IF(k>0,k,1)),pbase,IF(ISOMITTED(psiref),0,psiref),ev,IF(ISOMITTED(edge),0,edge),xv,TOCOL(xs),yv,TOCOL(ys),n,ROWS(xv),m,ROWS(yv),tx,0.25*MEDIAN(ABS(DROP(xv,1)-DROP(xv,-1))),VX,-kv*seepage_gradgrid(xs,ys,H,1,ev),VY,-kv*seepage_gradgrid(xs,ys,H,2,ev),bot,IF(INDEX(yv,1)<INDEX(yv,m),1,m),INC,MAKEARRAY(m-1,n,LAMBDA(jj,qq,LET(va,INDEX(VX,jj,qq),vb,INDEX(VX,jj+1,qq),IF(AND(ISNUMBER(va),ISNUMBER(vb)),ABS(INDEX(yv,jj+1)-INDEX(yv,jj))*(va+vb)/2,0)))),TRI,MAKEARRAY(m,m-1,LAMBDA(rr,jj,IF(bot=m,--(jj>=rr),--(jj<rr)))),PC,pbase+MMULT(TRI,INC),WSIDE,LAMBDA(rr,cc,cn,IF(OR(cn<1,cn>n),FALSE,IF(ABS(INDEX(xv,cn)-INDEX(xv,cc))>=tx,FALSE,IF(NOT(ISNUMBER(INDEX(H,rr,cn))),TRUE,INDEX(H,rr,cn)<>INDEX(H,rr,cc))))),MAKEARRAY(m,n,LAMBDA(rr,cc,IF(NOT(ISNUMBER(INDEX(H,rr,cc))),NA(),LET(wl,WSIDE(rr,cc,cc-1),wr,WSIDE(rr,cc,cc+1),IF(wl=wr,INDEX(PC,rr,cc),LET(cs,IF(wl,cc+1,cc-1),IF(OR(cs<1,cs>n),INDEX(PC,rr,cc),IF(NOT(ISNUMBER(INDEX(H,rr,cs))),INDEX(PC,rr,cc),INDEX(PC,rr,cs)-(INDEX(xv,cc)-INDEX(xv,cs))*(INDEX(VY,rr,cs)+INDEX(VY,rr,cc))/2))))))))));

/** Table s,x,y,h,vx,vy,vn,psi along segment A->B; v=-k grad h. seepage_segprofile(xs,ys,H,xA,yA,xB,yB,[n],[k],[edge]) */
seepage_segprofile = LAMBDA(xs, ys, H, xA, yA, xB, yB, [n], [k], [edge],
LET(np,IF(ISOMITTED(n),50,IF(n>0,n,50)),kv,IF(ISOMITTED(k),1,IF(k>0,k,1)),ev,IF(ISOMITTED(edge),0,edge),GX,seepage_gradgrid(xs,ys,H,1,ev),GY,seepage_gradgrid(xs,ys,H,2,ev),PS,seepage_psigrid(xs,ys,H,kv,0,ev),L,SQRT((xB-xA)^2+(yB-yA)^2),tx,(xB-xA)/L,ty,(yB-yA)/L,s,SEQUENCE(np+1,1,0,L/np),px,xA+s*tx,py,yA+s*ty,hv,seepage_hxy(xs,ys,H,px,py),vx,-kv*seepage_hxy(xs,ys,GX,px,py),vy,-kv*seepage_hxy(xs,ys,GY,px,py),vn,vx*ty-vy*tx,pv,seepage_hxy(xs,ys,PS,px,py),HSTACK(s,px,py,hv,vx,vy,vn,pv)));

/** {length, h avg, h min, h max, Q=psi(B)-psi(A), vn avg} for segment A->B. seepage_segstats(xs,ys,H,xA,yA,xB,yB,[k],[n],[edge]) */
seepage_segstats = LAMBDA(xs, ys, H, xA, yA, xB, yB, [k], [n], [edge],
LET(kv,IF(ISOMITTED(k),0,k),nv,IF(ISOMITTED(n),0,n),ev,IF(ISOMITTED(edge),0,edge),P,seepage_segprofile(xs,ys,H,xA,yA,xB,yB,nv,kv,ev),s,CHOOSECOLS(P,1),hv,CHOOSECOLS(P,4),pv,CHOOSECOLS(P,8),ds,DROP(s,1)-DROP(s,-1),L,MAX(s),Q,INDEX(pv,ROWS(pv))-INDEX(pv,1),HSTACK(L,SUM(ds*(DROP(hv,1)+DROP(hv,-1))/2)/L,MIN(hv),MAX(hv),Q,Q/L)));

/** Internal: TRUE if mesh cell (rw,cl) is soil (4 active corners, not a wall slot). seepage_cellok(xs,ys,H,rw,cl) */
seepage_cellok = LAMBDA(xs, ys, H, rw, cl,
LET(xv,TOCOL(xs),yv,TOCOL(ys),n,ROWS(xv),m,ROWS(yv),IF(OR(rw<1,cl<1,rw>m-1,cl>n-1),FALSE,IF(NOT(AND(ISNUMBER(INDEX(H,rw,cl)),ISNUMBER(INDEX(H,rw,cl+1)),ISNUMBER(INDEX(H,rw+1,cl)),ISNUMBER(INDEX(H,rw+1,cl+1)))),FALSE,LET(tx,0.25*MEDIAN(ABS(DROP(xv,1)-DROP(xv,-1))),ty,0.25*MEDIAN(ABS(DROP(yv,1)-DROP(yv,-1))),hA,INDEX(H,rw,cl),hB,INDEX(H,rw,cl+1),hC,INDEX(H,rw+1,cl),hD,INDEX(H,rw+1,cl+1),wx,AND(ABS(INDEX(xv,cl+1)-INDEX(xv,cl))<tx,hA<>hB,hC<>hD),wy,AND(ABS(INDEX(yv,rw+1)-INDEX(yv,rw))<ty,hA<>hC,hB<>hD),NOT(OR(wx,wy)))))));

/** Interior node, 4-point stencil: (a+b+c+d)/4 - the four neighbours in any order. seepage_stencil(a,b,c,d) */
seepage_stencil = LAMBDA(a,b,cValue,d,(a+b+cValue+d)/4);

/** No-flow edge (mirror, half cell): (2n+ta+tb)/4 - n = neighbour into the soil, ta, tb = neighbours along the edge. seepage_stencil1(n,ta,tb) */
seepage_stencil1 = LAMBDA(n,ta,tb,(2*n+ta+tb)/4);

/** Outer corner between two no-flow edges (quarter cell): (a+b)/2. seepage_stencil2(a,b) */
seepage_stencil2 = LAMBDA(a,b,(a+b)/2);

/** Re-entrant corner (three-quarter cell): (2fa+2fb+ha+hb)/6 - fa, fb = neighbours across full faces, ha, hb = neighbours across half faces. seepage_stencil3(fa,fb,ha,hb) */
seepage_stencil3 = LAMBDA(fa,fb,ha,hb,(2*fa+2*fb+ha+hb)/6);

/** Water density (g/cm^3) from temperature in degrees Celsius; cubic fit from the hydrometer example. */
water_density = LAMBDA(temperature,0.000000036052*temperature^3-0.0000075123*temperature^2+0.000052019*temperature+0.99991);

/** Water dynamic viscosity (g/(cm s)) from temperature in degrees Celsius; cubic fit from the hydrometer example. */
water_viscosity = LAMBDA(temperature,-0.00000010169*temperature^3+0.000011148*temperature^2-0.00056844*temperature+0.017772);

/** Water content w (fraction) from tare, wet and dry masses: (wet - dry)/(dry - tare). Accepts single values or columns; returns "" where the masses are missing. */
water_content = LAMBDA(tare, wet, dry,
    IFERROR((wet-dry)/(dry-tare),"")
);

/** Specific gravity of solids Gs (pycnometer): Ws/(Ws + Wfw - Wfws). Ws dry soil mass, Wfw flask + water, Wfws flask + water + soil; returns "" when undefined. */
specific_gravity = LAMBDA(Ws, Wfw, Wfws,
    IFERROR(IF(Ws/(Ws+Wfw-Wfws)=0,"",Ws/(Ws+Wfw-Wfws)),"")
);

/** Sieve analysis from masses retained (top sieve first): {mass passing, percent finer} for each sieve. */
sieve_passing = LAMBDA(retained,
    LET(
        total,     SUM(retained),
        remaining, total-SCAN(0,retained,LAMBDA(a,b,a+b)),
        finer,     IF(total=0,"",remaining/total*100),
        IF(total=0,"",HSTACK(remaining,finer))
    )
);

/** Hydrometer temperature correction (g/L) from water temperature T (°C), relative to 20 °C. */
hydrometer_correction = LAMBDA(T,
    1000*(0.99823-water_density(T)-0.000025*(T-20))
);

/** Hydrometer effective fall depth Hr (cm) from corrected reading Rt, calibration Hr = A·Rt + B, bulb volume Vb (cm³) and cylinder diameter D (cm). */
hydrometer_hfall = LAMBDA(Rt, A, B, Vb, D,
    LET(
        Ac, D^2*PI()/4,
        A*Rt+B-Vb/(2*Ac)
    )
);

/** Hydrometer equivalent particle diameter (mm) from Stokes law: temperature T (°C), fall depth Hr (cm), Gs and elapsed time (min). */
hydrometer_grainSize = LAMBDA(T, Hr, Gs, time,
    SQRT(30*water_viscosity(T)*Hr/(Gs-1)/981/water_density(T)/time)
);

/** Hydrometer percent finer (%) from dry mass W (g), corrected reading Rt, Gs and temperature T (°C); 152H hydrometer (factor 0.6226·Gs/(Gs-1)). */
hydrometer_percentFiner = LAMBDA(W, Rt, Gs, T,
    100/W*(Rt+hydrometer_correction(T))*0.6226*Gs/(Gs-1)
);

/** Hydrometer analysis in one call: {fall depth (cm), diameter (mm), percent finer (%)} for each reading. */
hydrometer_analysis = LAMBDA(time, Rt, temperature, W, Gs, D, Vb, a, b,
    LET(
        Ac,           D^2*PI()/4,
        distanceFall, a*Rt+b-Vb/(2*Ac),
        grainSize,    SQRT(30*water_viscosity(temperature)*distanceFall/(Gs-1)/981/water_density(temperature)/time),
        percentFiner, 100/W*(Rt+hydrometer_correction(temperature))*0.6226*Gs/(Gs-1),
        HSTACK(distanceFall,grainSize,percentFiner)
    )
);

/** Coefficient of consolidation cv by Casagrande log-time method. t, d: elapsed time and dial change from the start of the increment. details = TRUE returns {cv; d0; d100; d50; t50; t100; t_inflection; m_primary; m_secondary}. */
consolidation_log_time = LAMBDA(t, d, H_dr, [n_sec], [frac], [details],
    LET(
        ns,     IF(ISOMITTED(n_sec), 4, n_sec),
        fr,     IF(ISOMITTED(frac), 0.25, frac),
        tp,     FILTER(t, t > 0),
        dp,     FILTER(d, t > 0),
        lg,     LOG10(tp),
        NN,     ROWS(tp),
        sg,     SIGN(INDEX(dp, NN) - INDEX(dp, 1)),
        sl,     (DROP(dp, 2) - DROP(dp, -2)) / (DROP(lg, 2) - DROP(lg, -2)),
        asl,    sl * sg,
        jv,     SEQUENCE(NN - 2),
        preA,   IF(jv <= NN - ns - 1, asl, -1E+99),
        jA,     XMATCH(MAX(preA), preA),
        xA,     TAKE(lg, -ns),
        yA,     TAKE(dp, -ns),
        mA,     SLOPE(yA, xA),
        useA,   ABS(mA / INDEX(sl, jA)) < 0.6,
        rmax,   SCAN(-1E+99, asl, LAMBDA(acc, v, MAX(acc, v))),
        js,     XMATCH(1, (jv > 1) * (asl < fr * rmax)),
        preB,   IF(jv < js, asl, -1E+99),
        jB,     XMATCH(MAX(preB), preB),
        xB,     TAKE(DROP(lg, js), ns),
        yB,     TAKE(DROP(dp, js), ns),
        jk,     IF(useA, jA, jB),
        m_sec,  IF(useA, mA, SLOPE(yB, xB)),
        c_sec,  IF(useA, INTERCEPT(yA, xA), INTERCEPT(yB, xB)),
        k,      jk + 1,
        m_pri,  INDEX(sl, jk),
        c_pri,  INDEX(dp, k) - m_pri * INDEX(lg, k),
        lg_100, (c_sec - c_pri) / (m_pri - m_sec),
        d_100,  m_sec * lg_100 + c_sec,
        lg_4,   LOG10(4 * INDEX(tp, 1)),
        i_4,    XMATCH(1, --(lg >= lg_4)),
        d_4,    INDEX(dp, i_4 - 1) + (lg_4 - INDEX(lg, i_4 - 1)) * (INDEX(dp, i_4) - INDEX(dp, i_4 - 1)) / (INDEX(lg, i_4) - INDEX(lg, i_4 - 1)),
        d_0,    2 * INDEX(dp, 1) - d_4,
        d_50,   (d_0 + d_100) / 2,
        f,      (dp - d_50) * sg,
        i,      XMATCH(1, (DROP(f, -1) < 0) * (DROP(f, 1) >= 0)),
        lg_50,  INDEX(lg, i) + (d_50 - INDEX(dp, i)) * (INDEX(lg, i + 1) - INDEX(lg, i)) / (INDEX(dp, i + 1) - INDEX(dp, i)),
        t_50,   10 ^ lg_50,
        cv,     0.197 * H_dr ^ 2 / t_50,
        IF(IF(ISOMITTED(details), FALSE, details), VSTACK(cv, d_0, d_100, d_50, t_50, 10 ^ lg_100, INDEX(tp, k), m_pri, m_sec), cv)
    )
);

/** Coefficient of consolidation cv by Taylor square-root-of-time method; the initial straight line is detected automatically. details = TRUE returns {cv; d0; d100; t90; slope; n points}. */
consolidation_sqrt_time = LAMBDA(t, d, H_dr, [skip], [n_min], [k_sig], [details],
    LET(
        s,     IF(ISOMITTED(skip), 1, skip),
        n_0,   IF(ISOMITTED(n_min), 5, n_min),
        kk,    IF(ISOMITTED(k_sig), 2, k_sig),
        sq,    SQRT(t),
        NN,    ROWS(sq),
        MM,    NN - s,
        x,     FILTER(sq, SEQUENCE(NN) > s),
        y,     FILTER(d, SEQUENCE(NN) > s),
        kv,    SEQUENCE(MM),
        LT,    --(kv >= SEQUENCE(1, MM)),
        SH,    --(kv + 1 = SEQUENCE(1, MM)),
        Sx,    MMULT(LT, x),
        Sy,    MMULT(LT, y),
        Sxx,   MMULT(LT, x * x),
        Syy,   MMULT(LT, y * y),
        Sxy,   MMULT(LT, x * y),
        sl,    (kv * Sxy - Sx * Sy) / (kv * Sxx - Sx ^ 2),
        ic,    (Sy - sl * Sx) / kv,
        sse,   Syy - ic * Sy - sl * Sxy,
        se,    SQRT(IF(sse > 0, sse, 0) / (kv - 2)),
        res,   (MMULT(SH, y) - (ic + sl * MMULT(SH, x))) * -SIGN(sl),
        flag,  IFERROR((kv >= n_0) * (kv < MM) * (res > kk * se), 0),
        n,     IFERROR(XMATCH(1, flag), MM),
        m,     INDEX(sl, n),
        b_0,   INDEX(ic, n),
        diff,  d - (b_0 + (m / 1.15) * sq),
        iv,    SEQUENCE(NN),
        dnext, MMULT(--(iv + 1 = SEQUENCE(1, NN)), diff),
        i,     XMATCH(1, (iv >= s + n) * (iv < NN) * (diff * dnext <= 0)),
        xa,    INDEX(sq, i),
        xb,    INDEX(sq, i + 1),
        fa,    INDEX(diff, i),
        fb,    INDEX(diff, i + 1),
        sq_90, xa - fa * (xb - xa) / (fb - fa),
        cv,    0.848 * H_dr ^ 2 / sq_90 ^ 2,
        d_90,  b_0 + (m / 1.15) * sq_90,
        d_100, b_0 + (d_90 - b_0) / 0.9,
        IF(IF(ISOMITTED(details), FALSE, details), VSTACK(cv, b_0, d_100, sq_90 ^ 2, m, n), cv)
    )
);

/** Coefficient of consolidation cv by least-squares fit of Terzaghi U(Tv) to the readings before secondary compression (start found by consolidation_creep). details = TRUE returns {cv; d0; d100; t50; t90; t_start; rms}. */
consolidation_fitting = LAMBDA(t, d, H_dr, [skip], [n_min], [details],
    LET(
        s,    IF(ISOMITTED(skip), 1, skip),
        nm,   IF(ISOMITTED(n_min), 6, n_min),
        cr,   consolidation_creep(t, d, , , , TRUE),
        t_st, INDEX(cr, 4),
        tp,   DROP(t, s),
        dp,   DROP(d, s),
        pre,  --(tp < t_st),
        use,  IF(SUM(pre) >= nm, pre, SIGN(tp + 1)),
        tt,   FILTER(tp, use),
        dd,   FILTER(dp, use),
        NN,   ROWS(tt),
        Mrow, (2 * SEQUENCE(1, 12) - 1) * PI() / 2,
        ones, SEQUENCE(12, 1, 1, 0),
        Uf,   LAMBDA(z, IF(z < 0.05, SQRT(4 * z / PI()), 1 - MMULT(2 / Mrow ^ 2 * EXP(-z * Mrow ^ 2), ones))),
        sse,  LAMBDA(a, IFERROR(INDEX(LINEST(dd, Uf(a * tt), TRUE, TRUE), 5, 2), 1E+99)),
        ga,   10 ^ SEQUENCE(126, 1, -3, 0.04),
        ea,   MAP(ga, sse),
        ac,   XLOOKUP(MIN(ea), ea, ga),
        gb,   ac * 10 ^ SEQUENCE(81, 1, -0.04, 0.001),
        eb,   MAP(gb, sse),
        af,   XLOOKUP(MIN(eb), eb, gb),
        st,   LINEST(dd, Uf(af * tt), TRUE, TRUE),
        s_p,  INDEX(st, 1, 1),
        d_0,  INDEX(st, 1, 2),
        rms,  SQRT(INDEX(st, 5, 2) / (NN - 3)),
        cv,   af * H_dr ^ 2,
        IF(IF(ISOMITTED(details), FALSE, details), VSTACK(cv, d_0, d_0 + s_p, 0.197 / af, 0.848 / af, t_st, rms), cv)
    )
);

/** Secondary compression from the straight tail of d vs log t, found by working back from the last reading. Returns C_alpha_epsilon = |slope|/H_0 (or the slope when H_0 is omitted); details = TRUE returns {value; slope; n; t_start; d_start}. */
consolidation_creep = LAMBDA(t, d, [H_0], [n_min], [k_sig], [details], [frac],
    LET(
        n_0,   IF(ISOMITTED(n_min), 3, n_min),
        kk,    IF(ISOMITTED(k_sig), 3, k_sig),
        fr,    IF(ISOMITTED(frac), 0.05, frac),
        tp,    FILTER(t, t > 0),
        dp,    FILTER(d, t > 0),
        MM,    ROWS(tp),
        x,     SORTBY(LOG10(tp), SEQUENCE(MM), -1),
        y,     SORTBY(dp, SEQUENCE(MM), -1),
        rg,    ABS(INDEX(y, 1) - INDEX(y, MM)),
        kv,    SEQUENCE(MM),
        LT,    --(kv >= SEQUENCE(1, MM)),
        SH,    --(kv + 1 = SEQUENCE(1, MM)),
        Sx,    MMULT(LT, x),
        Sy,    MMULT(LT, y),
        Sxx,   MMULT(LT, x * x),
        Syy,   MMULT(LT, y * y),
        Sxy,   MMULT(LT, x * y),
        sl,    (kv * Sxy - Sx * Sy) / (kv * Sxx - Sx ^ 2),
        ic,    (Sy - sl * Sx) / kv,
        sse,   Syy - ic * Sy - sl * Sxy,
        se,    SQRT(IF(sse > 0, sse, 0) / (kv - 2)),
        res,   MMULT(SH, y) - (ic + sl * MMULT(SH, x)),
        flag,  IFERROR((kv >= n_0) * (kv < MM) * ((ABS(res) > kk * se) + (ABS(res) > fr * rg) > 0), 0),
        n,     IFERROR(XMATCH(1, flag), MM),
        m_sec, INDEX(sl, n),
        c_sec, INDEX(ic, n),
        t_st,  10 ^ INDEX(x, n),
        d_st,  c_sec + m_sec * INDEX(x, n),
        out,   IF(ISOMITTED(H_0), m_sec, ABS(m_sec) / H_0),
        IF(IF(ISOMITTED(details), FALSE, details), VSTACK(out, m_sec, n, t_st, d_st), out)
    )
);

/** One row per load increment for a whole test: cv, d0, d100, r1, rp, rs by log time, square-root time and fitting, then C_alpha_epsilon (19 columns). */
consolidation_table = LAMBDA(loads, load_no, t_all, d_all, D_ini, D_fin, h_0, dial_0, [n_drain],
    LET(
        nd,    IF(ISOMITTED(n_drain), 2, n_drain),
        blank, EXPAND("", 1, 19, ""),
        six,   LAMBDA(rr, rg, h_s, LET( cv_u, INDEX(rr, 1), da, INDEX(rr, 2), db, INDEX(rr, 3), Hd, (h_s + (da + db) / 2) / nd, r_1, ABS(da) / rg, r_p, ABS(db - da) / rg, col, SEQUENCE(1, 6), IF(col = 1, cv_u * Hd ^ 2, IF(col = 2, da, IF(col = 3, db, IF(col = 4, r_1, IF(col = 5, r_p, 1 - r_1 - r_p))))))),
        t_n,   IFERROR(--t_all, ""),
        d_n,   IFERROR(--d_all, ""),
        rowf,  LAMBDA(i, LET( L, INDEX(loads, i), ok, (load_no = L) * ISNUMBER(t_n) * ISNUMBER(d_n), IF(SUM(ok) < 8, blank, LET( tr, FILTER(t_n, ok), dr, FILTER(d_n, ok), tt, tr - INDEX(tr, 1), dd, dr - INDEX(dr, 1), rng, ABS(INDEX(D_fin, i) - INDEX(D_ini, i)), Hs, h_0 - (dial_0 - INDEX(D_ini, i)), ma_r, consolidation_log_time(tt, dd, 1, , , TRUE), mb_r, consolidation_sqrt_time(tt, dd, 1, , , , TRUE), mc_r, consolidation_fitting(tt, dd, 1, , , TRUE), ma, IF(SEQUENCE(3), IF(IFERROR(ROWS(ma_r), 0) >= 3, TAKE(ma_r, 3), ma_r)), mb, IF(SEQUENCE(3), IF(IFERROR(ROWS(mb_r), 0) >= 3, TAKE(mb_r, 3), mb_r)), mc, IF(SEQUENCE(3), IF(IFERROR(ROWS(mc_r), 0) >= 3, TAKE(mc_r, 3), mc_r)), ae_r, consolidation_creep(tt, dd, Hs), ae, IF(SEQUENCE(1, 1), ae_r), HSTACK(six(ma, rng, Hs), six(mb, rng, Hs), six(mc, rng, Hs), ae))))),
        DROP(REDUCE("", SEQUENCE(ROWS(loads)), LAMBDA(acc, j, VSTACK(acc, rowf(j)))), 1)
    )
);
